title: EXPOSURE: Explaining Sources of Uncertainty in Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2611.34248v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Shapley values in reinforcement learning are used to explain which observation features drive an agent's behavior and expected return, but not its certainty. Explaining certainty requires understanding how observation features influence different sources of return uncertainty, and Shapley values need the agent's prediction for every subset of visible features. We propose EXPOSURE, which uses one mask-aware belief network for both action selection and Shapley explanations. It explains the variance of the return, split into an observational part due to missing features and an inherent part due to the environment's own randomness, and the entropy of its belief over the masked features. In tic-tac-toe and Minesweeper, where exact Shapley values are computable, EXPOSURE gives more accurate explanations of expected return and its uncertainty, while uniquely explaining belief uncertainty.

translated_title: EXPOSURE：解释强化学习中不确定性的来源
translated_abstract: 强化学习中的Shapley值被用来解释哪些观测特征驱动了智能体的行为和期望回报，但无法解释其确定性。解释确定性需要理解观测特征如何影响回报不确定性的不同来源，而计算Shapley值需要智能体对每个可见特征子集的预测。我们提出EXPOSURE方法，它使用一个感知掩码的信念网络同时完成动作选择和Shapley解释。该方法解释回报的方差——将其分解为由于特征缺失导致的观测部分和由于环境自身随机性导致的固有部分——以及智能体对被掩码特征的信念熵。在井字棋和扫雷这两个可精确计算Shapley值的环境中，EXPOSURE对期望回报及其不确定性给出了更准确的解释，并且是唯一能解释信念不确定性的方法。
tldr: 提出EXPOSURE方法，利用单个感知掩码的信念网络同时进行动作选择和Shapley解释，将回报不确定性分解为特征缺失导致的观测部分与环境随机性导致的固有部分，从而更准确地解释强化学习智能体的期望回报、不确定性来源及信念不确定性。
en_tdlr: EXPOSURE uses a single mask-aware belief network for both action selection and Shapley explanations, decomposing return uncertainty into an observational part caused by missing features and an inherent part caused by environmental randomness, enabling more accurate explanations of an agent's expected return, its uncertainty sources, and uniquely, its belief uncertainty.
